summary: Implemented and committed the tea-backed Gitea source, additive migration, CLI/UI integration and tests. Taskboard checks pass; full workspace passes 845 tests under Node 24. Verified live creation/status/comments and actual BB desktop/mobile UI; pilot installed separately. Target sync fetched upstream/main and is current.

state.request: Add a Gitea tracker to Taskboard through the installed tea CLI. Support explicitly scoped tea login and owner/repo, list and live issue/comment details, issue creation with labels assignees milestones due date when available, native open/closed and status/* label Kanban transitions, CLI and UI configuration, append-only database upgrades, meaningful tests and live verification. Work in this fresh isolated checkout and user-authorized feat/taskboard-gitea-tea branch. Create a draft PR only in our GitHub fork aotd1/bb-plugins and install a separate local pilot plugin identity. Do not create upstream issues or PRs until seven days of actual pilot use have elapsed.
